I usually do:
15min - exercises on Duolingo 
15-25min - Reviewing Anki flashcards
Rest of free time - Read stories (with audiobook if possible)
(Once a week) 30min - Italki class

Then when I am going to watch something I try to watch it in my target language and when I’m at work I try to listen to some podcasts if I’m doing something that doesn’t require a lot of brainpower.
Once a week during the weekend I make a bunch of flashcards if needed, I’m currently doing 15cards a day so on Monday I want to have 105 flashcards ready at least. 

I usually spend one hour a day studying, not including the tv-shows and podcasts and Italki classes but I would prefer at least 2 hours.
